generatedFull.method: ChatGPT image edit using the original full-resolution scene as the authoritative target and each H3-extracted frame as a mouth/lower-jaw pose reference

usage: lower-face-crops/ is connected to the daytime user-facing runtime mouth layers. generated-full/ and frames/ remain editable source material.
note: frames/ contains the H3 video extractions. generated-full/ contains original-resolution full-scene candidates: closed/open are exact source composites, while release/small-open/half-open are ChatGPT-generated edits. lower-face-crops/ contains the deterministic 260x180 ComfyUI crops with a 10px feathered alpha edge; refine these PNG masks when preparing the final mouth-only cutouts.
